events.title: Prosecutor's Office Requests Amnesty Law to Release 12 CDR from Trial for Terrorism Offences
events.summary: The Spanish prosecutor's office asks that the Amnesty Law free twelve members of the CDR who are being tried for terrorism-related crimes.
